read_passage.description: Get the text of any passage, written the way you would say it: 'John 3:16', 'Psalm 23', 'Romans 8:28-39', '1 Cor 13:4-7'. Abbreviations work, a whole chapter or a run of chapters works too, and a range can cross from one book into the next. This is the action to reach for when you already know the reference; the other two let you pick instead. Comes back as plain text, as numbered verses, or as the publisher's HTML.

search.description: Find every verse in a translation that carries a word or phrase. All the words you give must appear in the verse, in any order, and '*' stands in for any run of letters ('wo*d' finds word, world and worshipped). Misspellings are allowed for. Narrow it to particular books, sort by best match or by Bible order, and page through more results. Each match comes back with its reference and its text.

description: Read and search the Bible from API.Bible, the American Bible Society's official Bible API: 350+ public-domain and Creative Commons translations, plus up to three copyrighted ones on the free plan. Ask for a passage the way you would say it ('John 3:16', 'Psalm 23', 'Romans 8:28-39'), or pick a chapter or verse from a list, and get the text back as plain words, as numbered verses, or as the publisher's own HTML. Search a whole Bible for a word or phrase, see which translations, books, chapters and verses are available, and step through the text one chapter or verse at a time for a daily reading, a devotional email or a scripture lookup in chat.
